## Source music scene requests and completion callbacks

Browser music now uses finite playback and a completion callback rather than native infinite looping. The HTML media element is reused as a transport carrier: completion resets its position and volume but preserves the accepted destination and fade counter. Muting, replacement and disposal prevent a queued old completion from reviving a stopped voice. Pointer/key gesture recovery still retries the current carrier.
